abstract: A 5q- anomaly associated with other chromosome anomalies was found in the infiltrated bone marrow of a patient with a highly malignant teratoma originally located in the mediastinum. There was no evidence of a second malignancy, and it is likely that the 5q- anomaly was, indeed, associated with the malignant teratoma cells.
abstract_ja: 縦隔に原発した悪性度の高い奇形腫の患者において、浸潤した骨髄に他の染色体異常とともに5q-異常が認められました。第二の悪性腫瘍の証拠はなく、この5q-異常は悪性奇形腫細胞に関連していたと考えられます。
